snippet.title: Souq Boss Official Multiplayer Gameplay Trailer - EN
snippet.description:
Wishlist Souq Boss Simulator on steam now!

Every Sheikh-sized fortune has to start somewhere. Yours starts with a tiny Baqala. Manage your shop, meet the locals, build your fortune, and invest across a 2002 Gulf city inspired by Old Dubai & Riyadh. Solo or with friends in online co-op. Become the Souq Boss. 

#indiegame #indiedev #steam #saudiarabia #uae #riyadh #jeddah #dubai #abudhabi
